notes.title: July 22 Update
notes.notes:
After receiving reports of misbehaving achievements we looked into it and managed to clean up a few minor bugs along the way. Thank you for your patience and your support!

Bugs

 Character play time achievements should be working correctly in all game modes
 Player slots in the multiplayer character selection screen should once again be open by default
 Player names in the multiplayer character selection screen should once again be displayed correctly

notes.title: May 19 Update
notes.notes:
It took a bit longer than expected, but here it is - the latest patch! This one adds a number of game settings and possible player combinations.

Features

 2-player co-op setting added to campaign
 Bots are now available in remote multiplayer
 Round setting added to multiplayer


Changes

 Campaign camera now keeps all characters in view, like in arena
 Multiple new resolutions added to graphics settings


Bugs

 Fixed remote multiplayer team setting replication
 Multiplayer games should no longer be able to start with only one team

notes.title: April 29 Update
notes.notes:
It's time for another patch for Bell Ringer! This one addresses some of the combat problems and expands the campaign game mode a bit.

Features

 Difficulty setting in campaign game mode
 Achievements for campaign completion


Changes

 Campaign monster spawn timings and locations have been adjusted
 Basic attack knockback will now diminish with repetitive use
 Increased hitbox sizes for more lenient collisions
 Normalized size of blood effects
 Gutrip is now armed to the tusks
 Campaign respawn location should now be selected based on monster presence


Bugs

 Special moves should no longer kill players in one hit
 Character platform jump precision should now be the same as for bots
 Characters should be less prone to losing their model in online games
 Opening the ingame menu should now correctly pause the campaign
 Player setup should now be correctly adjusted when entering the campaign start screen
 Monster death animations should now have a more consistent play rate

notes.title: April 22 Update
notes.notes:
We have processed the latest feedback and deployed a patch with fixes for the most critical bugs, plus a little treat.

Features

Campaign levels are now available in arena.


Bugs

Arena lobby chat should now display messages and scroll properly.
Fixed a bug that would cause player deaths to not be registered.
Fixed a bug that would crash the game when returning to the remote multiplayer screen.
Attempting to join an expired game should no longer lock the menu.

notes.title: March 22nd Update
notes.notes:
We've recently deployed a patch to Bell Ringer which fixes some of the initial issues that have been discovered.

Fixed:

Players should no longer be locked out of remote games after hosting a game.
Player names should now be displayed correctly in the remote game lobby.
Player character selections should now be displayed correctly in the remote game lobby.
Bot settings should now be displayed correctly in the local game lobby.
If the two last players in a round die simultaneously the game should no longer soft-lock.
The "Back-button" should now be enabled in local level select screen.
The remote games list should now be automatically refreshed upon entering screen.
Start button in remote game lobby should no longer prompt clients to press buttons (as the server is the only one that can start a game).

notes.title: Early Access Patch 25th February
notes.notes:
We've recently deployed a patch for Bell Ringer:

Added
You can now select difficulty on bots.
Rebinding Keyboard and Mouse Button has been added, Gamepad rebinding will come in a future update.
Various sound updates and a new music track added.


Fixed
Less placeholder graphics in the Main Menu.
Icons behind the Player GUI in an arena fight is now different depending on which character you are playing.
